cpu.note: Lease/adapter/bridge and console lease state fit existing upper CPU reservations. C maps include fixture code/buffers; whole two banks remain reserved.

stack_limit: Measured exercised call paths, not a C worst-case bound; Calypsi has no automatic entry stack checks.

manifest.qualification: Focused development checks only; full release and general compiler qualification remain separate.

demo.contents: Boot XEX, matching system disk, pinned ROM, short guide, license notices and checksums only

reemission_note: The later optional production-control switch reproduces every tested instrumented C byte, symbol and Task entry. Native compiled inputs are unchanged; original build provenance remains intact.

source_audit.memac_access: Only platform/altirraos/vbxe.c and vbxe-map.s in the hosted G3 image touch MEMAC/VRAM. Console, IRQ/NMI, SIO and ROM paths do not consume mapping shadows; aperture excludes loader, stacks and kernel state.
source_audit.boot_authorization: Explicit private launcher authorization after pinned cold boot plus exact identity/readable inactive checks; no inferred reset of an unknown owner.
source_audit.fault_exit: Launcher parks with live VBXE ownership on any fault/normal exit, including retained-owner removal rejection.
